mimeType.description:
The MIME type for this file type.  This will be a C3-specific MIME type
such as `application/vnd.c3.data+json` rather than the generic type (`application/json`).

extension.description: The canonical extension for this file type, such as `.json`.

title: Seed data files have a number of supported formats, each format is defined by its MIME type.
name: SeedFileFormat
